reported_full_suite_failure.cause: The old assertion sampled getAnimations after two requestAnimationFrame callbacks; it tested current lifetime rather than actual application animation creation. Route loading and short effect cleanup run asynchronously, so a late frame can miss a valid effect.

read_only_reproduction.result: Entire motion suite passed in isolation, consistent with load-dependent observation race.

native_creation_probe.limitation: The isolated diagnostic did not reproduce the exact full-suite missing snapshot; it verified the real native effect and exposed wall-time/frame-time separation.

repair.mechanism: Temporarily record actual native Element.animate calls and retain their original Animation object. Wait for real target visibility and assigned animation ID; assert target, positive duration, unique visible panel and route. After normal settle assert original owned Animation idle. Restore the original animate property descriptor in finally.
